steps.title: Pause new advances against the affected collateral
steps.draft:
INTERNAL ACTION MEMO — Pause new advances against the affected collateral
Case: B0060 · Finding: the same collateral is pledged to more than one lender (high confidence)
Action: Place a hold on further advances against the collateral named in the evidence until uniqueness is confirmed.
Based on:
  - 20 of the 20 loans that also sit in the public trust paid nothing into the Wells Fargo collection account in the last three months, though they are still on the tape: their payments are going somewhere else [ref S1-B0060-POOL_LOANS_PAID_ELSEWHERE-7d34b1b9]
  - 20 loans pledged to Wells Fargo match loans that the borrower's own public securitization (SYN-ABS-B0060) reports to investors, on every field allowing for small reporting differences, two months running. The SEC data has no VIN: ask for the VINs and titles to settle it [ref S1-B0060-PUBLIC_POOL_OVERLAP-0355b0d1]

Due: 2026-10-16 · Requires approval before it is carried out.
[DRAFT — synthetic demonstration data]

steps.title: Ask the other secured party for a payoff / estoppel letter
steps.draft:
DRAFT LETTER — Ask the other secured party for a payoff / estoppel letter
To: [the other secured party of record]
Re: Facility monitoring — request for information (B0060)

As part of our routine monitoring of the facility, we have identified items we need to reconcile:
  - 20 of the 20 loans that also sit in the public trust paid nothing into the Wells Fargo collection account in the last three months, though they are still on the tape: their payments are going somewhere else [ref S1-B0060-POOL_LOANS_PAID_ELSEWHERE-7d34b1b9]
  - 20 loans pledged to Wells Fargo match loans that the borrower's own public securitization (SYN-ABS-B0060) reports to investors, on every field allowing for small reporting differences, two months running. The SEC data has no VIN: ask for the VINs and titles to settle it [ref S1-B0060-PUBLIC_POOL_OVERLAP-0355b0d1]

Please provide a payoff or estoppel letter stating the collateral you claim, the amount outstanding, and whether any of it overlaps the listed assets by 2026-10-20.

This letter requests information to reconcile our records. It does not allege wrongdoing by any party.

[Credit officer], Wells Fargo
